citroen-ami|fiat-topolino.text: The Topolino's longer bumper covers add 125 mm to the Ami's length; wheelbase, width and height are the same.

subaru-solterra|toyota-bz4x.text: The Solterra sits 50 mm higher (raised ride height and roof rails); wheelbase, length and width are identical.

ford-tourneo-connect|volkswagen-caddy.text: carsized's Tourneo Connect entry is the long-wheelbase Grand version, the Caddy entry the standard one; both exist for both badges and share the body shell.

ford-transit-connect|volkswagen-caddy-ca.text: carsized's Transit Connect entry is the long-wheelbase version, the Caddy Cargo entry the standard one; both exist for both badges and share the body shell.

ford-tourneo-custom|volkswagen-caravelle.text: carsized's two entries are different wheelbase versions (L1 vs L2) of the same Ford-built vehicle.

bmw-x1|bmw-x2.text: Same wheelbase and width; the X2 is the 52 mm lower coupé-SUV body on the X1's platform, so the pair is shown as platform siblings.

img_notes.mercedes-benz-gla: Image and measurements show the outgoing H247 GLA (still sold in run-out); the new MMA-based GLA is not on carsized yet.
